## History

Aristotle was an ancient figure whose historical opinions were revived during discussions surrounding strange maritime phenomena. He notably admitted the existence of sea monsters in his writings, a belief that was later resuscitated alongside ancient legends.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008)_
